title: Fix #10964: Use VAT registration number fallback in FatturaPA file name
summary: FatturaPA file names now use VAT Registration Number as a fallback when Fiscal Code is blank, matching the transmitter identifier already used in the XML document.
key_points: Fiscal Code is checked first; if empty, VAT Registration No. is used for the transmitter identifier
File naming now aligns with the XML's IdTrasmittente/IdCodice field behavior
Helper method centralized to avoid duplicated fallback logic in GetFileName()
Existing files generated with Fiscal Code remain unchanged
Added unit tests for the fallback scenario
